svg.title: Native free-space Mach–Zehnder modulator — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: A sized 532 nm beam divides into equal-length arms. A native phase modulator writes a held phase into one arm; complementary camera ports measure the resulting interference. The workbench computes supported monochromatic camera interference and static phase drive. This free-space equivalent has no waveguides, electrodes, symbol stream, RF bandwidth, modulator chirp or bias-control servo.
